about: Model-provider lane falsifiers: each selftest entry breaks one falsify.py check, MP01 plants a wrapping add in counted_input_tokens so an overflowing repeated prefix no longer refuses, MP02-MP04 break the 60-second idle release behaviour, MP05-MP10 weaken the context-window admission tests, MP11 plants a nonzero cache size in the launched engine arguments, MP12-MP14 misreport the journal write outcome (a denied write as corrupt, a non-permission write as denied, and a denial without its operation), and MP15-MP16 bypass the shared journal write mapper at the replace and write call sites. The `did` and `wallet` commands share one provider-crate table with `provider`; PV43 maps `did` to the wallet manifest, PV44 and PV45 drop a did or wallet recovery target from PROVIDER_TARGETS, PV46 bypasses the refusal of an edit whose file does not exist, and PV47 and PV48 drop the model or the did confinement test harness target so a killed run leaves a mutated harness behind, and PV49 drops wallet's falsifier honesty test target, which wallet's list mutates (WP25). PV50 maps `capsule-identity` to the wasm-capsule manifest, and PV51-PV53 drop capsule-identity's source, test support or fixture target from PROVIDER_TARGETS, which the lab's list mutates. PV54 and PV55 remove or over-extend the failed test's own captured section that keeps a quoted child standard error out of the harness error search, and PV56-PV59 accept the end of the output as its closing delimiter, match the section header anywhere on a line, end the section at its last delimiter, remove only the first section, and PV60 lets the closing delimiter carry text after it. PV61 and PV62 move the loader or the Cargo check after the section removal, so a marker a test quotes inside its own section is no longer seen, PV63 lets the section header carry text after it, and PV64 lets a line that ends with the closing delimiter end a section. Files are relative to examples/agent-host.
